items.question: How do I file an insurance claim?
items.answer:
Filing a claim with AI Insurance Company is quick and easy. Choose the method that works best for you:

OPTION 1: ONLINE (Fastest - 5 minutes):
1. Visit www.aiinsurance.com/file-claim
2. Log in to your account
3. Click 'File New Claim'
4. Select policy and incident type
5. Describe what happened
6. Upload photos/documents
7. Submit - Get claim number instantly

OPTION 2: MOBILE APP:
1. Download 'AI Insurance' app (iOS/Android)
2. Tap 'File a Claim'
3. Take photos directly in app
4. Answer simple questions
5. Submit with one tap
6. Track claim status in real-time

OPTION 3: PHONE (24/7):
- Call: 1-800-CLAIMS-24 (1-800-252-4672)
- Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
- Average wait time: Under 2 minutes
- Claims adjuster walks you through process
- Emergency services dispatched if needed

OPTION 4: IN-PERSON:
- Visit any local branch office
- Bring: Policy number, photos, police report (if applicable)
- Office hours: Mon-Fri 9am-6pm, Sat 9am-2pm

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:
- Policy number (on your insurance card)
- Date and time of incident
- Description of what happened
- Photos of damage
- Police report number (for theft, vandalism, auto accidents)
- Contact info for other parties involved (if applicable)
- Repair estimates (if you have them)

AFTER FILING:
1. Receive claim number immediately
2. Adjuster assigned within 1 business day
3. Adjuster contacts you within 24-48 hours
4. Inspection scheduled (if needed)
5. Estimate provided within 3-5 business days
6. Approval and payment processed
7. Typical simple claims: 7-14 days
   Complex claims: 3-6 weeks

EMERGENCY SERVICES:
If you need immediate help:
- Water damage: Emergency mitigation team dispatched
- Fire damage: Board-up and security services
- Auto: Towing arranged through our network
- Home: Temporary housing assistance

All emergency services are covered under your policy (subject to limits).

items.question: How long does it take to process a claim and receive payment?
items.answer:
Claim processing times vary based on complexity, but we work quickly to get you paid:

TYPICAL TIMELINES:

Simple Claims (7-14 days):
- Windshield replacement: 1-3 days
- Minor auto collision: 5-10 days
- Small home damage: 7-14 days
- Theft (clear documentation): 10-14 days

Moderate Claims (2-4 weeks):
- Major auto collision: 2-3 weeks
- Home water damage: 2-4 weeks
- Storm damage: 2-4 weeks
- Fire damage (partial): 3-4 weeks

Complex Claims (4-8+ weeks):
- Total loss (auto or home): 4-6 weeks
- Major fire damage: 6-8 weeks
- Disputed liability: 4-12 weeks
- Multiple parties involved: 6-8 weeks

PROCESS BREAKDOWN:
Day 1: File claim, receive claim number
Day 1-2: Adjuster assigned
Day 2-3: Adjuster contacts you
Day 3-7: Inspection scheduled and completed
Day 5-10: Estimate and approval
Day 7-14: Payment issued

PAYMENT METHODS:
- Direct deposit: 1-2 business days (fastest)
- Check by mail: 5-7 business days
- Pay repair shop directly: Immediate (we pay contractor)

FACTORS THAT SPEED UP CLAIMS:
✓ Complete documentation upfront
✓ Photos of all damage
✓ Quick responses to adjuster requests
✓ Getting estimates promptly
✓ Using our preferred contractor network
✓ Clear police reports (if applicable)

FACTORS THAT SLOW DOWN CLAIMS:
✗ Incomplete information
✗ Hard to reach/slow responses
✗ Disputed facts or liability
✗ Waiting weeks for estimates
✗ Large-scale disasters (adjuster shortage)
✗ Investigation needed (fraud suspected)

ADVANCE PAYMENTS:
For larger claims, we can provide:
- Emergency advance: Within 24-48 hours
- Partial payment: As work progresses
- Final payment: After completion verified

Example (major home claim):
- Day 2: $5,000 emergency advance for temporary housing
- Week 2: $25,000 to start repairs
- Week 6: $40,000 final payment after inspection

STATE REQUIREMENTS:
Most states require insurers to:
- Acknowledge claim within 15 days
- Make decision within 30 days
- Issue payment within 5 days of approval
We typically beat these deadlines.

TRACKING YOUR CLAIM:
- Online portal: Real-time updates 24/7
- Mobile app: Push notifications
- Email updates: At each milestone
- Text alerts: Available upon request
- Call anytime: 1-800-CLAIMS-24

GUARANTEED RESPONSE TIMES:
- Claim acknowledged: Within 1 business day
- Adjuster assigned: Within 1 business day
- Initial contact: Within 48 hours
- Inspection scheduled: Within 5 business days (non-catastrophe)
- Estimate provided: Within 3 days of inspection
- Payment after approval: Within 3 business days

items.question: Will filing a claim increase my insurance rates?
items.answer:
This is one of the most common questions. Here's the honest answer:

IT DEPENDS ON THE CLAIM TYPE:

CLAIMS THAT TYPICALLY WON'T INCREASE RATES:
✓ Comprehensive auto claims:
  - Theft, vandalism, weather, hitting a deer
  - Not your fault = No rate increase
  - These are "no-fault" claims

✓ Home claims (natural disasters):
  - Hurricane, tornado, wildfire
  - Hail, wind, lightning damage
  - Acts of God beyond your control

✓ Not-at-fault auto accidents:
  - Other driver cited by police
  - Clear evidence you weren't at fault
  - Other driver's insurance pays (you file with them)

✓ Glass-only claims:
  - Windshield repair/replacement
  - Home window replacement
  - Usually won't affect rates

CLAIMS THAT MAY INCREASE RATES:
✗ At-fault auto accidents:
  - Average increase: 20-40%
  - Duration: 3-5 years
  - Major accidents: Up to 50% increase

✗ Multiple claims in 3 years:
  - 2 claims: 10-20% increase
  - 3+ claims: 20-40% increase or non-renewal
  - Pattern suggests higher risk

✗ Home liability claims:
  - Dog bite: 10-30% increase
  - Slip and fall: 10-20% increase
  - Shows property risk

✗ Water damage claims (preventable):
  - Burst pipe from lack of maintenance: May increase
  - Repeated water claims: Significant increase

OUR ACCIDENT FORGIVENESS PROGRAM:
- First at-fault accident: Forgiven (no rate increase)
- Eligibility: 5+ years claims-free
- Automatically included in Platinum and Gold policies
- Add-on: $50/year for Silver policies

CLAIM-FREE DISCOUNTS:
Stay claims-free and save:
- 3 years: 10% discount
- 5 years: 20% discount
- 10 years: 30% discount
- These discounts may be lost after filing claim

SHOULD YOU FILE OR PAY OUT OF POCKET?

File the claim if:
✓ Damage exceeds $1,000-$2,000 over your deductible
✓ Injury involved
✓ Liability to others
✓ You're not at fault
✓ Major damage (over $5,000)

Pay out of pocket if:
✗ Damage is close to deductible amount
✗ Minor damage (under $1,000)
✗ You have multiple recent claims
✗ Your rates are already high
✗ Risk of policy cancellation

Example decision:
- Damage: $2,500
- Deductible: $1,000
- Insurance would pay: $1,500
- Potential rate increase: $300/year for 3 years = $900 total
- Net benefit: $600 ($1,500 - $900)
In this case: FILE THE CLAIM

Example 2:
- Damage: $1,200
- Deductible: $1,000
- Insurance would pay: $200
- Potential rate increase: $300/year for 3 years = $900
- Net cost: -$700
In this case: PAY OUT OF POCKET

WE'RE HERE TO HELP YOU DECIDE:
- Call us before filing: 1-800-INSURANCE
- Ask: "If I file this claim, how might it affect my rates?"
- We'll review your history and give honest advice
- No obligation - you decide after hearing impact

TRANSPARENCY GUARANTEE:
- We'll tell you upfront if a claim might affect rates
- You can withdraw claim before processing (no impact)
- Rate increases explained clearly
- No surprises at renewal

items.question: Can I choose my own repair shop or contractor?
items.answer:
Yes! You have the right to choose where your vehicle or home is repaired. Here are your options:

AUTO REPAIR OPTIONS:

1. OUR PREFERRED NETWORK (Recommended):
Benefits:
✓ Guaranteed repairs for life of vehicle
✓ Faster processing (direct billing)
✓ No upfront payment needed
✓ Quality inspected by us
✓ Typically faster scheduling
✓ Loaner car often available
✓ We handle all paperwork

Network includes:
- 5,000+ certified shops nationally
- All major brands (Caliber, CARSTAR, ABRA, etc.)
- Independent shops that meet our standards

How it works:
- We send you list of 3-5 shops near you
- You choose from list
- Schedule directly with shop
- Shop bills us directly
- You pay only your deductible

2. YOUR OWN SHOP:
You can use ANY licensed repair shop:
- Get estimate from your shop
- Send estimate to us for approval
- We may send our adjuster to inspect
- You may need to pay shop, then we reimburse
- Warranty is between you and shop (not us)

We will STILL pay fair market rate even if not in network.

HOME REPAIR OPTIONS:

1. OUR CONTRACTOR NETWORK (Recommended):
Benefits:
✓ Pre-vetted and licensed
✓ Work guaranteed by us (1-3 years)
✓ Direct payment to contractor
✓ Project management support
✓ Quality inspections throughout
✓ Faster scheduling after disasters

How it works:
- We provide 2-3 qualified contractors
- You interview and choose
- Contractor provides detailed estimate
- We approve and manage payments
- Progress payments as work completes

2. YOUR OWN CONTRACTOR:
You're free to hire anyone:
- Must be licensed and insured
- Get detailed written estimate
- Submit to us for review
- We may request additional estimates for comparison
- You'll likely need to manage payments
- We reimburse based on approved amount

3. DO IT YOURSELF:
For handy homeowners:
- We pay you for materials and supplies
- Labor costs not paid (since you're doing it)
- Must provide receipts
- We may inspect completed work
- Only for minor repairs typically

IMPORTANT NOTES:

"Steering" is illegal:
- We cannot require you to use our network
- We cannot penalize you for using your own shop
- We must pay fair market rates regardless
- Your choice is protected by law

Estimate Differences:
- If your shop's estimate is higher than ours
- We'll review and discuss differences
- Typically we'll agree to supplement if reasonable
- Major differences may require inspection

Payment Process:

With Network Shop/Contractor:
1. We pay them directly
2. You pay only your deductible
3. No cash out of pocket
4. No waiting for reimbursement

With Your Own Shop/Contractor:
1. You may pay upfront
2. We reimburse you
3. Or we pay after work completion verification
4. Requires more paperwork and coordination

OUR RECOMMENDATION:
- For small claims (under $5,000): Your choice equally good
- For large claims (over $10,000): Network often easier
- For specialized work: Your specialist may be better
- For speed: Network typically faster
- For control: Your own contractor gives you more say

QUESTIONS BEFORE CHOOSING:
Ask your independent shop:
- Are you licensed and insured?
- What warranty do you provide?
- Will you work with my insurance?
- Can you handle direct billing?
- How long until you can start?

We support your choice either way and will work with any qualified professional!

items.question: What if my claim is denied? Can I appeal?
items.answer:
Yes, you absolutely have the right to appeal a denied claim. Here's how:

COMMON REASONS FOR DENIAL:

1. Not Covered Under Policy:
   - Excluded peril (flood, earthquake, maintenance)
   - Lapsed coverage (payment missed)
   - Incident outside policy period
   - Activity excluded (business use, etc.)

2. Policy Violations:
   - Material misrepresentation on application
   - Fraud or intentional damage
   - Failure to report timely
   - Breach of policy conditions

3. Insufficient Evidence:
   - Cannot verify loss occurred
   - Unable to determine cause
   - Disputed facts
   - Lack of documentation

4. Coverage Limits:
   - Damage exceeds policy limits
   - Special limits apply (jewelry, cash)
   - Sub-limits reached

YOUR APPEAL RIGHTS:

STEP 1: UNDERSTAND THE DENIAL (Within 5 days)
- Review denial letter carefully
- Identify specific reason(s)
- Check policy language cited
- Call your claims adjuster for clarification
- Phone: 1-800-CLAIMS-24

STEP 2: GATHER ADDITIONAL EVIDENCE (Within 15 days)
- Photos, videos, receipts
- Expert opinions or estimates
- Police/fire reports
- Witness statements
- Repair invoices
- Medical records (if applicable)

STEP 3: SUBMIT FORMAL APPEAL (Within 30 days)

Write to:
AI Insurance Company
Claims Appeal Department
PO Box 12345
Springfield, IL 62701

Email: appeals@aiinsurance.com

Include:
- Claim number
- Policy number
- Detailed explanation of why you disagree
- All supporting documentation
- Your contact information
- Specific policy language supporting your position

STEP 4: INTERNAL REVIEW (30-60 days)
- Independent reviewer (not original adjuster) evaluates
- May request additional information
- May conduct new inspection
- Written decision provided

STEP 5: SENIOR MANAGEMENT REVIEW (Optional)
- If still denied, request escalation
- Claims director or VP reviews
- Final internal decision
- Typically within 30 days

EXTERNAL OPTIONS IF STILL DENIED:

1. STATE INSURANCE DEPARTMENT:
- File complaint with your state regulator
- Free service, no lawyer needed
- State investigates on your behalf
- Contact: www.naic.org/state_web_map.htm

2. MEDIATION:
- Neutral third party helps negotiate
- Less formal than court
- Cost: $100-500 (often split with insurer)
- Faster than litigation (30-90 days)
- Non-binding in most cases

3. APPRAISAL:
- For disputes about damage amount (not coverage)
- Each side hires appraiser
- If they disagree, umpire decides
- Binding decision
- Cost: $500-2,000 typically

4. LITIGATION:
- Hire insurance attorney
- File lawsuit
- Can recover attorney fees if you win (in many states)
- Time: 1-3+ years
- Cost: Varies widely

OUR COMMITMENT:

- Fair Claims Pledge: Every claim reviewed fairly
- Multiple review levels available
- Customer advocates available: 1-800-INSURANCE ext. 4
- We'll explain any denial thoroughly
- Open to reconsideration with new evidence

IMPROVE YOUR APPEAL CHANCES:

✓ Submit comprehensive documentation
✓ Cite specific policy language
✓ Get expert opinions (contractors, engineers)
✓ Be professional and factual (not emotional)
✓ Provide timeline of events
✓ Show how similar claims were approved
✓ Respond promptly to information requests

WARNING SIGNS OF BAD FAITH:
- Unreasonable delays (6+ months)
- Refusing to explain denial clearly
- Ignoring evidence
- Changing reasons for denial
- Misrepresenting policy language

If you suspect bad faith:
- Document all communications
- File complaint with state insurance department
- Consult with insurance attorney (free consultations often available)

STATISTICS:
- About 5% of claims are denied initially
- Approximately 30% of appeals succeed
- Most common reason for reversal: New evidence provided

WE WANT TO PAY VALID CLAIMS:
- Our goal is customer satisfaction
- We review every appeal thoroughly
- Bring us new information and we'll reconsider
- Call us first before formal appeal: 1-800-INSURANCE
